name: Soracom, Inc.
summary: Soracom, Inc. supplies cellular connectivity services for the Internet of Things. Its Soracom SIM gives devices 2G, 3G and 4G LTE access using physical SIM cards or eSIM, while Soracom Arc links devices to its platform over Wi-Fi, Ethernet or satellite. Other services cover messaging via satellite, cloud integration, private IoT networking and the management of data and protocols. Dating from 2014, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
